short: Golden Retriever I Brought You a Sock
twin: the source print (womens-golden-retriever-i-brought-you-a-sock-heavyweight-hoodie, 3285 x 4065) has THREE lettered lines: I BROUGHT (rust), YOU A SOCK. (dark brown, low contrast) and YOU'RE WELCOME. (navy) at the bottom; the live print wins over the brief's two-line transcription, so all three lines are kept word for word. Clean row gaps around the art (rows 830-3844 kept: retriever, sock, poppies, ferns); the lines were cropped away and re-set. The brief's handle had 'retriever-retriever' (typo); the product uses womens-golden-retriever-i-brought-you-a-sock-embroidered-zip-hoodie.
